info.title: MedxDashboard API
info.description: HR management platform for UAE organizations. Generated from docs/build/spec.mjs. Permissions are listed in x-permission as resource:action.

tags.name: Authentication & Security
tags.description: Email/password sign-in with JWT sessions, account lockout, password policy, role-based permissions with data scopes, and sensitive-field masking.

tags.name: Dashboard
tags.description: One role-aware dashboard: an organization view for HR/Finance/Admin, a team view for managers and a self-service view for employees.

tags.name: Employee Management
tags.description: Central employee directory and a 360° profile: personal, employment, IDs & bank, compensation, documents, attendance, leave, performance, assets and history.

tags.name: Organization Structure
tags.description: Company, branches/locations, departments, teams, designations with salary bands, cost centers and an interactive organization chart.

tags.name: Recruitment / ATS
tags.description: Job requisitions with approval, a drag-and-drop candidate pipeline, interview scheduling and scorecards, offers, and one-click conversion of a hire into an employee with onboarding.

tags.name: Onboarding
tags.description: A 15-task checklist per new joiner grouped by owner (HR, IT, Manager, Employee) with a 7-step progress stepper.

tags.name: Attendance, Timesheets & Shifts
tags.description: Web/mobile/GPS/QR check-in with grace, late and overtime rules; daily view, monthly register, corrections with approval, reports, project timesheets and shift templates.

tags.name: Leave & Holidays
tags.description: Leave requests with manager → HR approval, balances with monthly accrual and carry forward, a team leave calendar and a configurable UAE holiday calendar.

tags.name: Payroll (UAE)
tags.description: Monthly payroll calculated from salary structure, attendance, leave, overtime, loans and adjustments; approve → lock → pay; payslips; WPS SIF export; salary register.

tags.name: Final Settlement & Gratuity
tags.description: Calculator for end-of-service benefits under UAE law plus pending salary, leave salary and recoveries, saved as an approvable statement.

tags.name: Performance, Goals & Promotions
tags.description: Goals/OKRs at company, department and individual level, review cycles with self and manager scores, KPIs with achievement, and promotions/salary revisions with approval.

tags.name: Expense Management
tags.description: Expense claims with receipts, a two-step approval (manager → finance) and reimbursement tracking.

tags.name: Documents & UAE Expiry Tracking
tags.description: Central document store for employee and company documents with versioning, verification and colour-coded expiry tracking for passports, Emirates ID, visas, work permits, contracts, insurance and licences.

tags.name: Asset Management
tags.description: Company equipment register with assignment, warranty, condition and maintenance history.

tags.name: Training & Development
tags.description: Training programs with calendar, seats, budget, certification and enrollments.

tags.name: HR Helpdesk
tags.description: Ticketing for HR requests with priorities, SLA timers, assignment, conversation threads and resolution.

tags.name: Employee Relations & Engagement
tags.description: Confidential case management for grievances and disciplinary actions; recognition wall, awards and engagement surveys.

tags.name: Announcements & Notifications
tags.description: Company announcements with categories, priority, audience and pinning; in-app notifications for every workflow event.

tags.name: Offboarding & Exit
tags.description: Resignation submission, manager and HR approval, notice period, a nine-item clearance checklist and exit completion that revokes system access.

tags.name: Reports & Analytics
tags.description: 20+ pre-built reports with charts and CSV export, and an analytics dashboard for workforce, attendance, recruitment and payroll.

tags.name: Audit Logs & Settings
tags.description: Immutable audit trail of sensitive actions and configuration for company, HR policies, attendance, leave, payroll, notifications, security, workflows, users, roles and integrations.

tags.name: Help Center
tags.description: In-app video guides and step-by-step documentation for every module, available to all users.
